summary: Recent discussions in the Spark community cover a proposal to merge GraphFrames into the core project, a plan to add a seven‑day buffer before upgrading third‑party dependencies, and a review request for a pluggable root pool comparator. Other topics include extending Data Source V2 push‑down to support more relational operators and a trial of an automated AI code review bot for new pull requests.

highlights.text: Proposal to merge GraphFrames into Apache Spark as an in‑tree module to provide a unified graph API and reduce maintenance burden

sources.title: [DISCUSS] SPIP: Bring GraphFrames into Apache Spark

highlights.text: Discussion to add a seven‑day buffer before upgrading third‑party dependencies to allow review and mitigate malicious releases

sources.title: Re: [DISCUSS] Set a buffer time before we upgrade to the latest version of dependencies

highlights.text: Review request for a pluggable root pool comparator that lets users supply a custom java.util.Comparator to order Spark’s root pool

sources.title: [DISCUSS] Review request: Pluggable root pool comparator (SPARK-58126)

highlights.text: Trial of an automated AI code review bot for Spark pull requests, processing four PRs concurrently and taking roughly an hour per review

sources.title: Re: [DISCUSS] Automated AI code review on new Spark PRs (trial)
